finding: All nine router HPO receipts inherited their family pilot stage label even though their frozen configs, trial identities, selection seed, and evidence class identify P2-E00 HPO.
impact: Receipt stage label only; no model, data, seed, training, scoring, metric, selection objective, or protected-access semantics changed.
remediation: Preserve existing receipts unchanged. Future gate receipts use the top-level frozen config stage_id when present.
